_note: Setup writes ~/.claude/skill-contracts.json from this file, one key per project: the project's folder name (lowercase), holding each step whose "when" holds for that project's answers (.bindwright/project.json, under advanced), with "when" left out. "*" applies to every project without a key of its own. A "when" entry is <answer>=<value> or <answer>!=<value>, and every entry must hold; a missing codeHost answer reads as github. Each step's "match" is a case-insensitive regex tested against a successful tool call's input (as JSON); "tools" limits which tools count.

start-session.step: the open items in the tracker (gh project item-list or gh issue list)
how far behind the dev branch is (git rev-list --count HEAD..origin/<dev>)
